args.subject: Child seat availability in London
args.body:
Hello New Car Rental team,

Do you have child seats available for car rentals in London? If so, could you please let me know which types are available, whether they need to be reserved in advance, and any additional charges?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed New Car Rental at **support@newcarrental.co.uk**, the address listed in their customer review, asking whether they offer child seats in London, which types are available, and whether advance reservations or extra charges apply.
